The DEFINITIONS/CLARITY audit (distinct from NFRA_ONTOLOGY which BUILDS the 14/10/6 layer, and from NFRA_SYSPARITY which measures REPRESENTATION parity). Seeded by the SYSPARITY ontology analyst: 10 grounded semantic-fog spots -> Andrew's 4 axes. ROOT FOG: 'ontology' is one word for two layers (CSE C0-C3 algebra vs the 14/10/6 archetype layer above it), never disambiguated. LOAD-BEARING METHOD NOTE: fog is a SEMANTIC property -- a word-grep verifies clarity in NEITHER direction (CVO proved this); acceptance is CVO's semantic-axis confirmation the ambiguity is GONE, not reworded. Prefer enforce-over-prose (a lint/decision-rule over a documented exception). WS-A DEFINITIONS (root two-layer fix + single-source the vocab + resolve Observer contradiction + purge Fork-Shadow=debt + variance_dimensions name) / WS-B LAYERING+NESTING (5-scheme crosswalk + enforce the Relation-vs-Role exception as a lint) / WS-C PROCESSES (deterministic tie-breakers for polymorphic Role + incorporation-mode decision-rule + pinned C2->C3 ownership) / WS-D LOGGED in system/sdk (RIDES SYSPARITY WS-4, supplies clarified defs, does not duplicate).
